BA-01.rules: **Dome** (radius 3): Absorbs 400 damage. After it breaks: 20s recharge.
BA-01.flavor: It hums at a very specific pitch.

BA-02.rules: Shots at cells within 4 cells: Spread ×2 and 30% chance to miss by one cell.
BA-02.flavor: Smells like burnt toast and victory.

BA-03.rules: Every 8s: catches one Flat or Arc shot aimed within 4 cells and throws it back at the shooter for 40% damage. Flammable.

BA-04.rules: Attracts Lightning and Arcane shots within 4 cells: takes 50% of the damage, the rest fizzles.
BA-04.flavor: It stands very still and pretends to be a tree.

BA-05.rules: Arc and Vertical damage within 2 cells −50%. Flying units cannot land here.

BA-06.rules: Every 25s for 6s: reflects Flat and Arc shots within 5 cells at the shooter for 60% damage.

BC-01.rules: Each wave, one random effect: 35% allies +30% healing, 25% +40 XP for 3 units, 20% +3 Citizens, 20% nothing. Loot.
BC-01.flavor: A frog appears. That is the nothing.

BC-02.rules: Every 30s: the invader closest to the Core teleports to the gate and is Stunned 2s. Flammable.

BC-03.rules: After 2 Timestops: hatches a dragon whelp (Assault, gains 1 Rank every 40s up to Rank 3). If it falls, a new egg takes 2 Timestops. Flammable.

BC-04.rules: Enemies in the room and adjacent rooms: Dancing 2s every 8s. Flammable.
BC-04.flavor: Left arm in. Right arm out. Everyone shake.

BC-05.rules: Enemies in the room and adjacent rooms: Floating 3s, then fall for 40 Impact damage. Cooldown 15s.

BC-06.rules: The first enemy that opens it takes 120 Impact damage and is Swallowed 5s. Loot. Flammable.
BC-06.flavor: Do not open. Do not look at its teeth.

BC-07.rules: Every 4s: enemies in the room are knocked back 2 cells. Allies are unaffected.
BC-07.flavor: Best next to the Core Chamber.

BC-08.rules: Enemies in the room: −35% speed and attack speed. Allies: +10%. Flammable.
BC-08.flavor: Tea time is always now. Slowly.

BC-09.rules: Once per match, on click: all invaders teleport to the gate and are Stunned 3s. Own buildings lose 15% HP.
BC-09.flavor: Please do not press the red button.

BF-01.rules: Unlocks the Weapons line. +1 Roster slot.
BF-01.flavor: The tuba plays reveille. With burps.

BF-02.rules: Unlocks the Arcane line. Arcane Artillery: +10% range.
BF-02.flavor: The books whisper. The shelves argue.

BF-03.rules: Unlocks the Beast line. Beast units +10% HP. Crew in adjacent rooms −10%. Flammable.
BF-03.flavor: Smells like a very large cat. Several.

BF-04.rules: Unlocks the Tech line. +1 Gun Slot (workshop roof).

BF-05.rules: Unlocks the Crypt line. 15% of fallen allied Assault and Defender units in the bastion rise as skeletons (12s, 50% HP).

BF-06.rules: Unlocks the Frost line. Fire damage to adjacent buildings −25%. Frost units +10% damage.

BF-07.rules: Unlocks the Flora line. Buildings within 2 cells regenerate 1 HP/s.
BF-07.flavor: Please do not feed the plants. They ask.

BF-08.rules: Unlocks the Air line. +1 Gun Slot (Air Artillery only). Flammable.
BF-08.flavor: Tied up with a very long rope.

BF-09.rules: Unlocks the Blessing line. Each wave, 2 random allies get Blessed (40).

BF-10.rules: Unlocks the Chaos line. 10% of newly spawned units are Chaos-born: random ×1.3 damage, ×1.3 HP, +30% speed or 2 HP/s regeneration.
BF-10.flavor: Open drawer three. No, not that one.

BH-01.rules: 3 Treatment Slots, 6 HP/s each. Healing Source. Flammable.
BH-01.flavor: The thermometer is also the flag.

BH-02.rules: 1 Treatment Slot, 8 HP/s. Healing Source. Flammable.

BH-03.rules: 4 Treatment Slots, 4 HP/s. Entering removes Burning, Poisoned, Slimed and Cursed, then +8% speed for 20s. Healing Source.

BH-04.rules: Aura (radius 3): Allies heal 3 HP/s. Holds 2 units. Healing Source. Flammable. Fire damage taken ×2.
BH-04.flavor: The mushrooms hum. Nobody knows the tune.

BH-05.rules: 1 Treatment Slot, 20 HP/s. Patient gains 8 XP and loses all debuffs. Healing Source.

BH-06.rules: 6 Treatment Slots, 5 HP/s. Aura (radius 3): Allies heal 2 HP/s. Healing Source.
BH-06.flavor: The water tastes like a second chance.

BH-07.rules: 6 Treatment Slots, 6 HP/s. Healing Source. **Rebirth**: Dead units return after 5s with 50% HP and Rank (once per wave). Fire damage taken ×2.

BP-01.rules: 2 Gun Slots. Artillery on it takes −25% Splash damage.
BP-01.flavor: The merlons have faces. They look stern.

BP-02.flavor: Planks, ropes, and a very serious flag.

BP-03.rules: 1 Gun Slot. Artillery in this bastion: +4 range, Spread −30%.

BP-04.rules: 2 Gun Slots on a floating cloud: Flat shots cannot hit them.

BP-05.rules: 1 Gun Slot. Flat shots cannot hit the Artillery on it.
BP-05.flavor: A garden gnome sits on the roof.

BP-06.rules: 4 Gun Slots. Floats above the bastion: Flat shots cannot hit it. Artillery on it: +8 range.
BP-06.flavor: The waterfall flows upward. Nobody asks.

BS-01.rules: Automatic on every outer edge and between modules. Blocks movement and Line of Fire.
BS-01.flavor: Every crack has a beetle living in it.

BS-02.rules: Replaces up to 4 wall segments. Splash damage does not pass through. Attackers get −20% speed. Fire damage taken ×1.3.
BS-02.flavor: A cherry on top. That is tactics.

BS-03.rules: Replaces up to 4 wall segments. Impact and Poison damage taken −30%.
BS-03.flavor: There is a face in one of the rivets.

BS-04.rules: Replaces up to 4 wall segments. Arcane and Lightning damage taken −50%.

BS-05.rules: Enemies crossing it take 10 Impact damage/s and −20% speed. Allies are unaffected.

BS-06.rules: The first 2 enemies each wave fall in: 60 Impact damage, Stunned 4s. Does not affect Flying or Spirit units.

BS-07.rules: Replaces the main Gate. Every 30s with an enemy in the gateway: 100 Impact damage to all below, gateway closed 5s.
BS-07.flavor: The chains squeak. The teeth do not.

BS-08.rules: Enemies crossing it: Confused 3s, then immune for 10s.
BS-08.flavor: A lone hat lies on the floor. Nobody asks.

BS-09.rules: Removes Burning from units and buildings within 3 cells. Fire damage to buildings within 3 cells −50%.

BT-01.rules: Shoots enemy units. +50% damage vs Fleeing units. Flammable.
BT-01.flavor: The archer waves. It is part of the job.

BT-05.rules: Summons 3 hornets: Flying, 12 HP, Leash 6 cells. Lost hornets return every 8s.
BT-05.flavor: The hornets pay rent in stings.

BT-06.rules: Targets a random enemy. Chains to 2 more at 50%. ×1.5 damage vs Wet. Immune to Lightning.
BT-06.flavor: Do not stand near the pointy bit.

BT-07.rules: Only targets Flying units. Damage ×2. Flammable.
BT-07.flavor: The pelican has opinions about airships.

BT-08.rules: Beam sweeps the field: Confused 2s (once per 6s per target). Reveals Invisible units.

BU-01.rules: +3 Citizen cap. Citizens respawn every 4s instead of 5s. Flammable.
BU-01.flavor: The dog snores. So does everyone else.

BU-02.rules: Units in the room and adjacent rooms get Fed. Crew in range work +20% faster. Flammable.

BU-03.rules: Repairs adjacent buildings for 8 HP/s. Repair units within 5 cells work +25% faster.
BU-03.flavor: Please take a number. And a nail.

BU-04.rules: Alarm: Defender Leash ×2, Citizens flee to shelter, enemies in the bastion are marked.
BU-04.flavor: It rings. Then it rings again.

BU-05.rules: 4 Civilian slots. Occupants are untargetable while the door (350 HP) stands. Citizens do not work here.

BU-06.rules: Allies on it move ×3 faster. Enemies avoid it.
BU-06.flavor: Hold on. Do not hold on.

BU-07.rules: Pulls all units on it, enemies too, in the arrow direction at ×2 speed.

BU-08.rules: +1 Reinforce per wave for all Assault cards.

BU-09.rules: Fleeing allies (Retreat) teleport to the nearest free Healing Source.
BU-09.flavor: It hums. It does not explain.

BU-10.rules: +1 Squad for all Defender and Civilian cards.
BU-10.flavor: Everything in here is useful. Somehow.

BU-11.rules: At Timestop: +1 kept card (draw 5, keep 4) and +10s build time. Multiple shrines do not stack.

BW-01.rules: Newly spawned Assault and Defender units gain Hardened.
BW-01.flavor: The furnace grins. That is normal.

BW-02.rules: Newly spawned Assault and Defender units take −15% damage.
BW-02.flavor: Every helmet has a dent. On purpose.

BW-03.rules: Artillery: −12% reload time. Explosive (80 Fire damage, radius 1). Flammable.
BW-03.flavor: Do not smoke. Do not argue with the sign.

BW-04.rules: Artillery hits additionally apply Burning 3s. Explosive (120 Fire damage, radius 1).
BW-04.flavor: Every day is a festival. Briefly.

BW-06.rules: Newly spawned Defender and Civilian units gain Rune Skin.

BW-07.rules: Newly spawned units start with +25 XP. Units standing here gain +0.6 XP/s.

BW-08.rules: All allied units gain +25% XP from all sources. Flammable.

BW-09.rules: Kill XP ×2. The killer gains +10% speed for 5s. Loot.
BW-09.flavor: Third shelf: one very large tooth.

BW-10.rules: Newly spawned units get a random potion: +25% damage, +25% speed, +25% HP, or Invisible until the first hit (max 4s).
BW-10.flavor: Stir clockwise. Unless it asks otherwise.

BW-11.rules: Newly spawned Assault and Defender units start at Rank 2 (140 XP) and are Hardened.
BW-11.flavor: It does not hit things. Things happen near it.

UA-02.rules: Applies Burning to hit Wood and Organic buildings.
UA-02.flavor: His hat smokes. So does he.
UA-02.talent: **Spark Jump**: Burning spreads to 1 adjacent cell.

UA-03.flavor: Loud, cheap, and the beard is smoking.

UA-04.rules: Fires a goblin: 25 HP, 6 damage/s, lives 12s. Counts half for Conquest.
UA-04.flavor: One goblin waves from the muzzle.

UA-05.rules: Fires an orc: 70 HP, 14 damage/s, lives 20s, Structure ×2.

UA-06.rules: Applies Frozen 5s to buildings and Chilled to units in the impact room.
UA-06.flavor: The yeti holds the funnel. Gently.

UA-07.rules: **Spore Cloud** (8s): 6 Poison damage/s in the room. Citizens work at −50%.
UA-07.talent: **Spore Drift**: Cloud spreads to the next room.

UA-08.rules: **Ink**: Towers and ranged units within radius 1 get Blinded 8s.
UA-08.flavor: The squid lives in a barrel. Rent is ink.

UA-09.rules: 6 bats hit random cells in a 3×3 area. Prefers staffed rooms.
UA-09.flavor: Bats with tiny teeth. Tiny. Teeth.

UA-10.flavor: The bolt comes with a bow on it.

UA-11.rules: Chains to up to 3 cells. ×1.5 damage vs Metal. 20% chance: Shorted 3s.
UA-11.flavor: Her hair stands on end. All of it.

UA-12.flavor: The mole wears goggles. For the dust.

UA-13.rules: Units up to 150 HP and Civilians in the impact room become Frogged 6s.
UA-13.flavor: The tongue is the throwing arm.

UA-14.rules: Flying. Hovers 10 cells in front of the bastion. Drops bombs as Arc shots.
UA-14.flavor: Shaped like a whale. Behaves like one.

UA-15.rules: ×2 damage to Bone and Spirit units.
UA-15.flavor: One pipe coughs. The choir ignores it.

UA-17.rules: Pierces 5 obstacles. ×1.3 damage to the Core.

UA-18.rules: Splash 2. Rolls on 3 cells for 50% damage. Ends Burning. Units in the room get Wet.

US-01.talent: **Rattle Head**: Revives once after 4s with 30% HP.
US-01.flavor: There was soup in the pot once. Now it is armor.

US-02.flavor: The sack is only empty for show.

US-03.talent: **Pumpkin Seeds**: 30 Fire damage to adjacent cells.

US-04.flavor: Aims with one eye. Hops with the other.
US-04.talent: **Two Bolts**: Hits 2 targets in a line.

US-06.talent: **Ice Trail**: Enemies on the trail get −20% speed.
US-06.flavor: Belly first is also a plan.

US-07.flavor: The goose is the dangerous one.
US-07.talent: **Egg Bomb**: On hit, lays an egg: 20 Fire damage after 2s.

US-08.rules: Burrowed until it surfaces 2 cells behind the outer wall.
US-08.flavor: The mole hill has a doorbell.

US-09.rules: Ignores walls and traps. On hit (Civilian): 20% chance of Feared.

US-11.rules: Applies Chilled on hit. On death: slush 3s, −20% speed.

US-12.rules: Immune to Knockback and Stunned. Reflects 25% of Flat damage.

US-13.rules: On death: spore cloud 5s, 4 Poison damage/s.
US-13.talent: **Spore Trail**: Leaves small clouds while running.

US-14.rules: **Wound Up**: +5% attack speed per second in combat (max +50%). Resets out of combat.

US-15.rules: Disguised as Loot: revealed only when adjacent. First bite ×3.
US-15.talent: **Gold Teeth**: Swallows enemies up to 30 HP.

US-16.rules: **Chaos Bolt**: Random damage type. 10% misfire: Frogged 3s, 50% on itself.
US-16.talent: **Mastery**: No misfires. Picks the best type.

US-17.rules: **Noodle Net**: Rooted on up to 3 targets. Eats Rooted Civilians.

US-18.flavor: Do not swat. Do not swat.

US-19.rules: Flying. Lands in the yard near its target. **Fire Breath**: Cone 2. Structure ×1.

US-20.rules: Invisible until its first attack. First attack ×3 vs Civilians.
US-20.talent: **Smoke Bomb**: Invisible again for 2s after the first attack.

US-21.rules: **Stomp**: Splash 2, Knockback 1. Throws goblins: range 8, 20 damage. Structure ×1.2.

US-22.rules: Flying, lands in the yard. Cone 3. Structure ×1.3. **Roar** (8s): Feared within 3 cells.

US-23.rules: **Mimicry**: On first contact, copies HP and attack of the strongest enemy unit within 3 cells ×1.2.
US-23.talent: **Perfect Copy**: Copies its Talent as well.

UV-01.talent: **Pan Whirl**: Every 6s hits all adjacent enemies.
UV-01.flavor: The fried-egg crest is serious business.

UV-02.rules: **Petrify**: Rests as a statue (−50% Impact damage taken, Poison immune) until an enemy is within 3 cells.
UV-02.talent: **Dive**: On Alarm, flies to the Core Chamber.

UV-03.rules: **Slime Trail**: enemies in its cell get −35% speed.

UV-04.rules: **Shield Wall**: −25% damage taken per adjacent Defender (max −50%).
UV-04.talent: **Shell Dome**: Splash damage −50% for the group.

UV-05.rules: **Control Zone**: Enemies in the same room cannot pass.
UV-05.flavor: Not on the list. Not coming in.

UV-06.rules: At 0 HP: leaves Rubble (blocks 5s), then reforms with 40% HP (once per wave).

UV-07.rules: Every 6s: Rooted 2s on one target. Fire damage taken ×1.5.
UV-07.flavor: He was here before the walls.

UV-08.rules: Immune to Feared, Poisoned and Stunned. On death: pile of armor (blocks 4s).

UV-09.flavor: Good boy. Good boy. Good boy.

UV-10.rules: Aura (radius 3): Enemies get −30% speed and attack speed.

UV-11.rules: **Fire Breath**: Cone 3, applies Burning. Fire immune.
UV-11.flavor: Do not pet. Do not feed.

UV-12.rules: Stationary. Overheats after 8s of fire: 2s pause.

UV-14.rules: Taunt (radius 3). Civilians in the room take −30% damage.
UV-14.talent: **Very Well, Sir**: Taunt affects ranged units.

UV-15.rules: Disguised as a door. Swallows one enemy up to 150 HP: Swallowed 8s.

UV-16.rules: **Last Muster**: Revives once at 50% HP. While alive, Conquest is fully blocked.
UV-16.flavor: The last of his order. The first to arrive.

UV-17.rules: Repairs buildings in the room for 10 HP/s. Taunt (same room).
UV-17.flavor: He knows every door. He mops after.

UZ-01.rules: Heals the most wounded ally within 4 cells for 8 HP/s. Healing Source.
UZ-01.flavor: The soup helps. Don't ask with what.

UZ-02.rules: Repairs buildings for 12 HP/s. Rebuilds Rubble in 13s.

UZ-03.rules: Aura (same and adjacent rooms): Allies take −15% damage and deal +10% damage.

UZ-04.rules: Every 10s: Allies in the room get Fed.

UZ-05.rules: Removes Burning in the room and adjacent rooms. Fire damage to buildings within 2 cells −40%.

UZ-06.rules: Aura (3 cells): Allies get Spurred and are immune to Feared.
UZ-06.flavor: The bagpipe is a pig bladder.

UZ-07.rules: **Class**: Up to 2 pupils in the same room gain 1.2 XP/s. Patients in healing rooms count.

UZ-08.rules: Applies Blessed to allies, once per target every 15s.

UZ-09.rules: Every 12s: Random potion on an ally within 4 cells: +25% damage for 10s, +25% speed, heal 40 or shield 30.

UZ-10.rules: Sets up to 3 traps in corridors: 50 Impact damage, Rooted 2s. Rebuilds them.

UZ-11.rules: **Hive**: 4 bees sting invaders in the room (3 Impact damage/s each). Honey heals allies in the room for 3 HP/s.
UZ-11.flavor: The bees are paid in honey.

UZ-12.rules: **Decoy**: 30% of enemies within 3 cells target it. Dodges 50% of attacks.

UZ-13.rules: Fleeing allies +20% speed. Alarm triggers 2s earlier. Defender Leash +1.

UZ-14.rules: 20% of fallen allied Assault and Defender units rise as skeletons (15s, 50% HP).

UZ-15.rules: **Foresight**: Enemy shots at cells within 2 cells have a 35% chance to miss.

UZ-16.talent: **Thunderstorm**: Every 5s, 20 Lightning damage to one target.

UZ-17.rules: Each wave: +1 Reinforce for 2 random troop cards. Spawns are staggered 25% faster.

UZ-18.rules: Buildings within 3 cells: +20% max HP. Repairs adjacent buildings 8 HP/s.
UZ-18.talent: **Scrap Golem**: Rubble becomes a golem (150 HP, 8/s, 20s).

UZ-19.rules: Once per wave: Fully heals the most wounded ally, +60 XP. Buildings within 3 cells: +15% HP. Healing Source.
